stories.title: Man charged with second-degree murder for April death in Saskatoon
stories.summary: A 38-year-old man is facing a second-degree murder charge in relation to the death of Wray Musqua, who was found unresponsive by Saskatoon police officers in April.

stories.title: Woman found safe after alleged car theft near Prince Albert: RCMP
stories.summary: Shaylynn Ermine, 29, is described by Saskatchewan RCMP as five-feet, four-inches tall and 130 lbs., with brown eyes and black, shoulder-length hair.

stories.title: Is your relative honoured with a Geo-Memorial?
stories.summary: The project highlights a provincial tradition that began in 1947, when Saskatchewan started naming geographical features after its war dead.

stories.title: Saskatoon police officer seriously injured after being hit by vehicle
stories.summary: The Saskatoon Police Service has confirmed to Global News that an officer is seriously injured after being hit by a vehicle in a construction zone on Circle Drive.

stories.title: Man wanted for second-degree murder arrested in Regina: RCMP
stories.summary: Steven Kishayinew, the Prince Albert man accused of killing a 66-year-old man in Rose Valley, Sask., was arrested in Regina, the RCMP said.

stories.title: Regina officer accused of keeping banned gun turned in for destruction
stories.summary: An amnesty is a temporary period where people can surrender newly prohibited firearms for destruction without facing criminal penalties.

stories.title: Saskatchewan government proposes restrictions for MAID eligibility
stories.summary: Saskatchewan's government is working to enshrine regulations on MAID eligibility by defining what exactly disqualifies a patient seeking medical assistance in dying.

stories.title: Second-degree murder suspect on the loose in Saskatchewan: RCMP
stories.summary: Steven Kishayinew is wanted for second-degree murder. The RCMP said he is known to frequent Regina, Prince Albert, Rose Valley and Fishing Lake First Nation.

stories.title: Premier Scott Moe calls federal budget ‘best in a decade’
stories.summary: Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe says he plans to work with the federal government on a cost sharing model for infrastructure projects lacking from the federal budget.

stories.title: Shaping Saskatchewan: Gabrielle Senft
stories.summary: Saskatchewan rugby product Gabrielle Senft has had a tremendous international career, representing both her province and country on a global stage.
